dataset_source: UCI Parkinson's Disease Classification dataset 470 (checksum-verified cached mirror)

dataset_provenance.structural_validation: 756 recordings, 252 subjects, required columns, finite acoustic features

analysis_definition.classification_probability_source: reported separately for raw, Platt-scaled, and isotonic probabilities
analysis_definition.aggregation_conformal_source: each strategy's own uncalibrated subject-level probability

probability_variables.raw_conformal_calibration_probs: raw selected-model mean probability for each calibration subject
probability_variables.raw_conformal_test_probs: raw selected-model mean probability for each held-out development subject
probability_variables.platt_calibration_probs: parallel Platt-scaled calibration-subject probability; not used for conformal scores
probability_variables.platt_test_probs: parallel Platt-scaled development-subject probability used for calibrated classification summaries
probability_variables.isotonic_test_probs: parallel isotonic development-subject probability used only for calibrated classification summaries

limitations: Sex is the only available demographic subgroup
Research use only; no clinical validation
